extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the toolbar.

extDescription.message: Export the current page, or a selected element, to a clean PDF — entirely on-device.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

backgroundsHint.message: Off produces a lighter, ink-friendly file.

printStylesLabel.message: Use the page's own print stylesheet

printStylesHint.message: Off exports what you see on screen. Turn this on if a site is designed to print well.
printStylesHint.description: Explains the print-stylesheet toggle in the popup and options page.

statusPicking.message: Click elements on the page — each becomes a page. Press Enter to export, Esc to cancel.

statusSuccessElements.message: Saved $FILENAME$ — $COUNT$ elements, each starting a new page.
statusSuccessElements.description: Shown after an element export. $COUNT$ is always 1 or more.

engineCdp.message: Rendered with Chrome's print engine — text stays selectable.

engineCanvas.message: Rendered with the fallback renderer — the PDF is an image, so its text is not selectable.

ordinal1.description: Position an element will take in the exported PDF. The picker shows these instead of a tag or class name, so keep them short enough for a small on-page label.

ordinalNumbered.description: Position past the tenth, where a written-out name stops being easier to read than a number.

pickerHint.message: Click elements to add them · ↑ ↓ widen or narrow · Esc to cancel

pickerHintSelected.message: $COUNT$ selected — each becomes a page · Enter to export · Esc to cancel

pickerNothingPicked.message: Pick at least one element first.

pickerTooMany.message: That is the most elements one export can hold ($LIMIT$).

errorRestrictedPage.message: Chrome does not allow extensions to read this page, so it cannot be exported. Try it on an ordinary web page.

errorNoActiveTab.message: No active tab to export. Open a page and try again.

errorDebuggerUnavailable.message: Chrome's print engine is unavailable in this browser, and the fallback renderer could not be used either.

errorDebuggerInUse.message: Another tool is already attached to this tab — usually DevTools. Close it and try again.

errorPermissionDenied.message: exporter does not have permission to read this tab. Click the exporter icon on the page you want to export.

errorFileAccessDenied.message: Chrome blocks extensions from reading local files. To export this page, open chrome://extensions, find exporter, and turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

errorPageNotCapturable.message: This page blocks capture, so it cannot be exported. PDFs already open in Chrome's viewer cannot be re-exported.

errorNothingSelected.message: No elements were selected, so there was nothing to export.

errorElementGone.message: The elements you selected are no longer on the page. Pick them again.

errorRenderFailed.message: Rendering failed or took too long. Very long pages can time out — try exporting a section instead.

errorEmptyResult.message: The page produced an empty PDF. Nothing was saved.

errorTooLarge.message: The PDF is too large to save this way. Try a smaller paper size or export a section instead.

errorDownloadFailed.message: Chrome could not save the file.

errorDownloadCancelled.message: Save cancelled. Nothing was written to disk.

errorUnknown.message: Something went wrong and the export did not finish.

optionsIntro.message: These are the settings every new export starts from. You can still change them per export in the popup.

privacyBody.message: exporter works entirely on your device. It makes no network requests, has no account, and collects no data of any kind.
